# Same-size comparison: Qwen family vs decision models (text benchmark)

**EXPLORATORY: framed after the Part 2 results were seen; only contrasts (1) and (2) were pre-registered**

From saved replies only (`part2_same_size.yaml`); choices in WORKLOG 2026-10-14, "Same-size comparison". Numbers only.

- Accuracy: exact answer per question; unanswered = wrong. 95% CIs: Wilson per question, bootstrap over items for the mean of 4 (each item's share of its 4 questions right).
- Unreadable: summary `parse_failure_rate` (items with at least one answer that couldn't be read).
- Latency p50: median over items. `Modal compute_s` = GPU time on Modal without queueing (`raw.remote.compute_s`); `round trip` = the recorded `latency_s`; for cumulative runs, the 4 sequential calls together.
- $: logged tokens x `configs/prices.yaml` (checked 2026-10-12); `self-hosted, GPU time` = no token price.

## Paired contrasts

Difference = first row minus second, on the same items. Per question: paired bootstrap 95% CI, exact McNemar (discordant items: first only / second only), Holm across all 20 question tests; **bold** = Holm p < 0.05. Mean of 4: paired bootstrap CI only.
